title: Fix bugs in a Go JSON config loader
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in a JSON config loader (wrong field name in struct tags, missing error return, default value never applied).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in config.go.

Bug 1 — Config.Host json tag: `json:"hostname"` should be `json:"host"`
  Fix: change the struct tag to `json:"host"`

Bug 2 — ParseConfig ignores unmarshal error:
  Fix: return the error from json.Unmarshal: `if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &c); err != nil { return c, err }`

Bug 3 — EffectivePort returns 0 instead of defaultPort:
  Fix: change `return 0` to `return defaultPort`

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: EffectivePort returns defaultPort when port is 0
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
